theorems.name: Submission.iwl_restriction_theory
theorems.statement: (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsMeasureRepresentation X μ v → ∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → X.massOn W < ∞) ∧ (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S₁ S₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsRestriction X A S₁ → IsRestriction X A S₂ → S₁ = S₂) ∧ (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → X.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ μ : Measure (Eucl P), IsMassMeasure X μ ∧ (∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U k, IsRestriction X A S) ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsRestriction X A S → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → S.massOn W = μ (W ∩ A))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
